description: This file contains JavaScript functions for toggling visibility of various form sections on a website setup page, specifically handling site defaults, session paths, log directories, and GUID settings.
external_files: HTML form elements with IDs: setup_site_session, setup_site_log_dir, setup_site_guid_section, etc.

methods.name: toggleSiteDefaults()
methods.description: Toggles the display of multiple form sections based on the 'setup_site_defaults' checkbox's state.

methods.name: toggleSession()
methods.description: Shows or hides the session path section based on the 'setup_site_custom_session_path' checkbox.

methods.name: toggleLogDir()
methods.description: Shows or hides the log directory section based on the 'setup_site_custom_log_dir' checkbox.

methods.name: toggleGUID()
methods.description: Shows or hides the GUID section based on the 'setup_site_specify_guid' checkbox.
